description: Ministry of  Mahaweli Development and Environment -  Order to Prohibit the  Manufacture of Food Containers, Plates, Cups, Spoons from expanded Polystyrene
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory instrument issued under the National Environmental Act, No. 47 of 1980. It contains a prohibition order on specific activities (manufacture and sale of polystyrene food containers) made by the President using statutory powers. The content focuses on establishing a regulatory framework and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
